snippet.title: Carrier Command 2 - Official Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Take control of a naval carrier at the heart of a futuristic war in a tactical sim that blends real-time strategy with first-person piloting in a complete command-to-cockpit experience. Gather intel, plan attacks, then deploy and pilot military vehicles as you conquer territory and secure resources. Carrier Command 2 is coming to consoles soon!
